name: engineering
description: Gaia's spec-driven software delivery lifecycle: intake, architecture, planning, implementation, testing, and release. Provides stage playbooks (architecture documentation, default tech stack, execution planning, engineering delivery, UI engineering, formal testing, and end-to-end process orchestration) plus two agents — a delivery lead that orchestrates those playbooks from request to tested change, and an independent verifier that makes the ready / not-ready call on work it did not write.
